description.en: 52 Medicare Advantage plans in Maine for 2026. Top carriers: Martin's Point, Humana, Aetna. Avg $20/mo. AEP Oct 15 to Dec 7, 2026.

subhero.en: Maine has 52 Medicare Advantage plans available in 2026, with about 229,000 beneficiaries enrolled statewide (a 59% MA penetration rate, well above the national average). Average monthly premium: $20. Statewide average Star Rating: 3.6.
subhero.es: Maine tiene 52 planes Medicare Advantage disponibles en 2026, con aproximadamente 229,000 beneficiarios inscritos a nivel estatal (59% de penetracion MA, muy por encima del promedio nacional). Prima mensual promedio: $20. Calificacion promedio estatal: 3.6 estrellas.

quickAnswer.en: In 2026, Maine has 52 Medicare Advantage plans available statewide and about 229,000 MA enrollees, a 59% MA penetration rate that ranks well above the roughly 55% national average. The statewide average monthly premium is $20, close to the national MA average of about $14 to $22 depending on methodology. Martin's Point Generations Advantage leads Maine enrollment as the state's largest homegrown carrier, followed by Humana, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield, and WellCare. The Annual Election Period runs October 15 to December 7, 2026, for coverage starting January 1, 2027.
quickAnswer.es: En 2026, Maine tiene 52 planes Medicare Advantage disponibles a nivel estatal y aproximadamente 229,000 inscritos en MA, una tasa de penetracion MA del 59% que supera el promedio nacional de aproximadamente 55%. La prima mensual promedio estatal es de $20, cercana al promedio nacional MA de $14 a $22 segun la metodologia. Martin's Point Generations Advantage lidera la inscripcion en Maine como la aseguradora local mas grande del estado, seguida por Humana, Aetna, UnitedHealthcare, Anthem Blue Cross and Blue Shield y WellCare. El Periodo Anual de Eleccion se realiza del 15 de octubre al 7 de diciembre de 2026, para cobertura que comienza el 1 de enero de 2027.

introParagraphs.en: Maine had roughly 229,000 residents enrolled in a Medicare Advantage plan in 2026, about 59% of the state's Medicare-eligible population, a penetration rate that runs notably higher than the roughly 55% national average reported by KFF. That high penetration reflects decades of strong local-carrier presence: Martin's Point Health Care, a Portland-based nonprofit, has built its Generations Advantage brand into the dominant Medicare Advantage option across most of Maine's 16 counties.
introParagraphs.es: Maine tuvo aproximadamente 229,000 residentes inscritos en un plan Medicare Advantage en 2026, alrededor del 59% de la poblacion elegible para Medicare del estado, una tasa de penetracion notablemente mas alta que el promedio nacional de aproximadamente 55% reportado por KFF. Esa alta penetracion refleja decadas de fuerte presencia de aseguradoras locales: Martin's Point Health Care, una organizacion sin fines de lucro con sede en Portland, ha construido su marca Generations Advantage como la opcion dominante de Medicare Advantage en la mayoria de los 16 condados de Maine.

introParagraphs.en: Maine's 2026 plan year brought real disruption. Martin's Point discontinued three plans affecting roughly 28,000 members, Aetna dropped two statewide plans affecting about 5,000 people, and Anthem ended two Anthem/MaineHealth Advantage plans affecting roughly 3,300 members, part of a broader industry pullback as CMS tightened Star Rating bonus payments and rural cost pressures mounted. Confirm your [Medicare eligibility](/en/medicare-eligibility) and re-shop during AEP if your plan was among those discontinued.
introParagraphs.es: El ano de plan 2026 de Maine trajo una interrupcion real. Martin's Point descontinuo tres planes que afectaron aproximadamente a 28,000 miembros, Aetna elimino dos planes estatales que afectaron a unas 5,000 personas, y Anthem termino dos planes Anthem/MaineHealth Advantage que afectaron aproximadamente a 3,300 miembros, parte de un retroceso mas amplio de la industria mientras CMS endurecia los pagos bonus por Calificacion de Estrellas y aumentaba la presion de costos rurales. Confirme su elegibilidad para Medicare y vuelva a comparar planes durante el AEP si su plan estaba entre los descontinuados.

introParagraphs.en: Rural geography shapes the Maine Medicare Advantage market more than in most states. Cumberland and York counties in southern Maine offer 20 or more plans with competitive premiums, while Washington and Piscataquis counties in the rural north and Downeast region offer as few as 4 to 7 plans with premiums running $20 to $25 higher per month. This guide covers the 2026 Maine Medicare Advantage market: plan counts, carriers, what to look for when shopping, and the enrollment dates that matter. Annual Election Period is October 15 to December 7, 2026, with coverage starting January 1, 2027.
introParagraphs.es: La geografia rural moldea el mercado de Medicare Advantage de Maine mas que en la mayoria de los estados. Los condados de Cumberland y York en el sur de Maine ofrecen 20 planes o mas con primas competitivas, mientras que los condados de Washington y Piscataquis en el norte rural y la region Downeast ofrecen tan solo 4 a 7 planes con primas $20 a $25 mas altas por mes. Esta guia cubre el mercado Medicare Advantage de Maine 2026: numero de planes, aseguradoras, que buscar al comprar y las fechas de inscripcion que importan. El Periodo Anual de Eleccion es del 15 de octubre al 7 de diciembre de 2026, con cobertura que comienza el 1 de enero de 2027.

intro.en: Maine Medicare Advantage shoppers face a market where geography drives most of the meaningful differences between plans. Here's what matters when comparing Maine plans for 2026:
intro.es: Los compradores de Medicare Advantage en Maine enfrentan un mercado donde la geografia impulsa la mayoria de las diferencias significativas entre planes. Esto es lo que importa al comparar planes de Maine para 2026:

items.en: Provider network and hospital affiliation. Martin's Point plans route through its own Martin's Point Health Care network and MaineHealth hospitals; Anthem/MaineHealth Advantage plans also anchor to MaineHealth. Confirm your primary care physician and preferred hospital, whether MaineHealth, Northern Light Health, or Central Maine Healthcare, are in-network before enrolling.
items.es: Red de proveedores y afiliacion hospitalaria. Los planes de Martin's Point pasan por su propia red Martin's Point Health Care y los hospitales de MaineHealth; los planes Anthem/MaineHealth Advantage tambien se anclan a MaineHealth. Confirme que su medico de atencion primaria y hospital preferido, ya sea MaineHealth, Northern Light Health o Central Maine Healthcare, esten en la red antes de inscribirse.

items.en: Prescription drug coverage (formulary). Most Maine MA plans bundle Part D. Check that your specific medications appear on the plan's formulary at a tier you can afford. The 2026 Part D out-of-pocket cap is $2,100 across all plans, a meaningful protection if you take expensive specialty drugs.
items.es: Cobertura de medicamentos recetados (formulario). La mayoria de los planes MA de Maine incluyen Part D. Verifique que sus medicamentos especificos aparezcan en el formulario del plan en un nivel que pueda pagar. El tope de gastos de bolsillo Part D 2026 es $2,100 en todos los planes, una proteccion importante si toma medicamentos especializados costosos.

items.en: Star Ratings. CMS rates Medicare Advantage plans 1 to 5 stars annually. Maine's statewide weighted-average Star Rating for 2026 is 3.6, below the roughly 3.8 national average, reflecting recent Star Rating declines that hit several Maine plans, including some Martin's Point offerings, harder than average.
items.es: Calificaciones de estrellas. CMS califica los planes Medicare Advantage de 1 a 5 estrellas anualmente. La calificacion promedio ponderada de estrellas de Maine para 2026 es 3.6, por debajo del promedio nacional de aproximadamente 3.8, reflejando descensos recientes en las Calificaciones de Estrellas que afectaron a varios planes de Maine, incluyendo algunas ofertas de Martin's Point, mas que el promedio.

items.en: Rural network adequacy. Washington, Piscataquis, and Aroostook counties have fewer specialists and hospitals overall, so a plan's network can feel thin even when the premium looks attractive. PPO plans from Humana and Aetna offer more flexibility to travel for specialty care in these areas.
items.es: Adecuacion de la red rural. Los condados de Washington, Piscataquis y Aroostook tienen menos especialistas y hospitales en general, por lo que la red de un plan puede sentirse limitada incluso cuando la prima parece atractiva. Los planes PPO de Humana y Aetna ofrecen mas flexibilidad para viajar por atencion especializada en estas areas.

items.en: Extras (dental, vision, hearing, transportation, OTC allowance). Maine's harsh winters and long distances between providers make transportation benefits especially valuable; several Maine MA plans include rides to medical appointments and OTC allowances of $50 to $150 per month.
items.es: Beneficios extras (dental, vision, audicion, transporte, subsidio OTC). Los inviernos duros de Maine y las largas distancias entre proveedores hacen que los beneficios de transporte sean especialmente valiosos; varios planes MA de Maine incluyen viajes a citas medicas y subsidios OTC de $50 a $150 por mes.

items.en: Maximum out-of-pocket (MOOP). Maine MA plans cap your annual in-network out-of-pocket spending. The 2026 federal MOOP ceiling for in-network MA is $9,250 (down $100 from $9,350 in 2025); most Maine plans set theirs between $6,400 and $8,000. Original Medicare has no MOOP.
items.es: Maximo de gastos de bolsillo (MOOP). Los planes MA de Maine limitan su gasto anual de bolsillo dentro de la red. El techo federal MOOP 2026 para MA dentro de la red es $9,250 (bajo $100 desde $9,350 en 2025); la mayoria de los planes de Maine lo fijan entre $6,400 y $8,000. Medicare Original no tiene MOOP.

intro.en: Maine Medicare and Medicare Advantage beneficiaries face several enrollment windows in 2026. Missing one can mean waiting months for your next chance or facing a late enrollment penalty.
intro.es: Los beneficiarios de Medicare y Medicare Advantage en Maine enfrentan varias ventanas de inscripcion en 2026. Perder una puede significar esperar meses para la siguiente oportunidad o enfrentar una multa por inscripcion tardia.

note.en: Switch between Original Medicare and MA, change MA plans, or change Part D plans. Coverage starts January 1, 2027. This is the window Maine residents affected by 2026 plan discontinuations should use to re-shop.
note.es: Cambie entre Medicare Original y MA, cambie de plan MA, o cambie de plan Part D. La cobertura comienza el 1 de enero de 2027. Esta es la ventana que los residentes de Maine afectados por las descontinuaciones de planes 2026 deben usar para volver a comparar opciones.

label.en: Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period (MA OEP)
label.es: Periodo Abierto de Medicare Advantage (MA OEP)

note.en: If you're already in an MA plan, you can switch to a different MA plan or return to Original Medicare. One switch only.
note.es: Si ya esta en un plan MA, puede cambiar a otro plan MA o regresar a Medicare Original. Un solo cambio.

date.es: ventana de 7 meses alrededor de su 65 cumpleanos

note.en: Starts 3 months before your 65th birthday month, includes the birth month, and runs 3 months after. Enroll in Medicare Parts A and B first, then choose MA or Original Medicare plus Part D.
note.es: Comienza 3 meses antes del mes de su 65 cumpleanos, incluye el mes de nacimiento y se extiende 3 meses despues. Inscribase primero en Medicare Partes A y B, luego elija MA o Medicare Original mas Part D.

note.en: Triggered by moving out of your plan's service area, losing employer coverage, qualifying for MaineCare (dual eligible), or your plan being discontinued (as happened to about 36,000 Mainers for 2026). Typically a 2-3 month window.
note.es: Activado al mudarse fuera del area de servicio de su plan, perder cobertura del empleador, calificar para MaineCare (doble elegible), o si su plan es descontinuado (como le sucedio a unos 36,000 residentes de Maine para 2026). Tipicamente una ventana de 2-3 meses.

intro.en: Maine Medicare Advantage shoppers should know about a few state-specific rules and programs that don't exist in most other states:
intro.es: Los compradores de Medicare Advantage en Maine deben conocer algunas reglas y programas especificos del estado que no existen en la mayoria de los otros estados:

description.en: Maine is one of only a handful of states requiring insurers to offer Medigap policies of equal or lesser benefit on a guaranteed-issue basis year-round, with no medical underwriting, as long as you haven't gone more than 90 days without continuous Medigap coverage. That makes switching from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare plus Medigap far less risky in Maine than in most states.
description.es: Maine es uno de los pocos estados que exige a las aseguradoras ofrecer polizas Medigap de beneficio igual o menor bajo emision garantizada durante todo el ano, sin suscripcion medica, siempre que no haya pasado mas de 90 dias sin cobertura Medigap continua. Eso hace que cambiar de Medicare Advantage a Medicare Original mas Medigap sea mucho menos arriesgado en Maine que en la mayoria de los estados.

label.es: D-SNPs de doble elegibilidad de MaineCare

description.en: Maine residents who qualify for both MaineCare (Maine's Medicaid program) and Medicare can enroll in a Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP), offered in 2026 by UnitedHealthcare (UHC Dual Complete) and other carriers. These plans typically carry $0 premiums, $0 copays for primary care, and coordinate MaineCare as secondary payer.
description.es: Los residentes de Maine que califican tanto para MaineCare (el programa Medicaid de Maine) como para Medicare pueden inscribirse en un Plan de Necesidades Especiales de Doble Elegibilidad (D-SNP), ofrecido en 2026 por UnitedHealthcare (UHC Dual Complete) y otras aseguradoras. Estos planes generalmente tienen $0 de prima, $0 de copago para atencion primaria y coordinan MaineCare como pagador secundario.

description.en: Maine's State Health Insurance Assistance Program, run through the Office of Aging and Disability Services, Maine's five Area Agencies on Aging, and Legal Services for Maine Elders, offers free, unbiased one-on-one Medicare Advantage counseling, especially valuable given the 2026 plan discontinuations.
description.es: El Programa Estatal de Asistencia de Seguro de Salud de Maine, administrado a traves de la Oficina de Servicios para Adultos Mayores y Discapacidades, las cinco Agencias de Area sobre el Envejecimiento de Maine, y Legal Services for Maine Elders, ofrece asesoria gratuita e imparcial individual sobre Medicare Advantage, especialmente valiosa dado las descontinuaciones de planes de 2026.

label.es: Transporte de invierno y extras rurales

description.en: Several Maine MA plans build in extra transportation rides and telehealth emphasis specifically because harsh winters and long rural distances make in-person specialist visits harder to reach in Aroostook, Washington, and Piscataquis counties.
description.es: Varios planes MA de Maine incorporan viajes de transporte adicionales y enfasis en telesalud especificamente porque los inviernos duros y las largas distancias rurales dificultan las visitas presenciales a especialistas en los condados de Aroostook, Washington y Piscataquis.

heading.en: Medicare Advantage vs Original Medicare in Maine
heading.es: Medicare Advantage vs Medicare Original en Maine

paragraphs.en: Maine residents choosing between Original Medicare (Parts A and B) plus a [Medigap supplement](/en/glossary/medicare-advantage-vs-original-plus-medigap) and standalone Part D, versus Medicare Advantage, face a real trade-off shaped by geography. Medigap plus Part D typically runs $150 to $300 per month in Maine, but gives you nationwide provider freedom and access to any doctor who accepts Medicare, valuable if you winter in Florida or travel to Boston for specialty care. Medicare Advantage bundles hospital, medical, and usually drug coverage for a statewide average of $20 per month in 2026, but ties you to a defined network that can feel thin in rural counties.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Maine que eligen entre Medicare Original (Partes A y B) mas un suplemento Medigap y Part D independiente, versus Medicare Advantage, enfrentan una compensacion real moldeada por la geografia. Medigap mas Part D generalmente cuesta $150 a $300 por mes en Maine, pero da libertad de proveedor a nivel nacional y acceso a cualquier medico que acepte Medicare, valioso si pasa el invierno en Florida o viaja a Boston para atencion especializada. Medicare Advantage agrupa cobertura hospitalaria, medica y generalmente de medicamentos por un promedio estatal de $20 por mes en 2026, pero lo ata a una red definida que puede sentirse limitada en condados rurales.

paragraphs.en: Rural Maine residents in Washington, Piscataquis, or Aroostook counties, where MA networks are thinnest, often lean toward Original Medicare plus Medigap precisely because it removes network restrictions entirely. Southern Maine residents in Cumberland or York counties, where 20-plus MA plans compete for enrollment and networks are deeper, more often find Medicare Advantage delivers comparable access at a lower monthly cost plus dental, vision, and hearing extras that Original Medicare does not cover.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes rurales de Maine en los condados de Washington, Piscataquis o Aroostook, donde las redes MA son mas limitadas, a menudo se inclinan hacia Medicare Original mas Medigap precisamente porque elimina por completo las restricciones de red. Los residentes del sur de Maine en los condados de Cumberland o York, donde compiten mas de 20 planes MA por la inscripcion y las redes son mas profundas, encuentran con mas frecuencia que Medicare Advantage ofrece acceso comparable a un costo mensual mas bajo mas extras de dental, vision y audicion que Medicare Original no cubre.

paragraphs.en: Maine's continuous Medigap guaranteed-issue rule changes this calculus compared to most states. Because Maine insurers must offer Medigap policies of equal or lesser benefit on a guaranteed-issue basis year-round (as long as you haven't had a coverage gap over 90 days), Mainers who try Medicare Advantage and later want to switch back to Original Medicare plus Medigap generally face far less medical underwriting risk than beneficiaries in most other states.
paragraphs.es: La regla de emision garantizada continua de Medigap de Maine cambia este calculo en comparacion con la mayoria de los estados. Debido a que las aseguradoras de Maine deben ofrecer polizas Medigap de beneficio igual o menor bajo emision garantizada durante todo el ano (siempre que no haya tenido una brecha de cobertura de mas de 90 dias), los residentes de Maine que prueban Medicare Advantage y luego quieren volver a Medicare Original mas Medigap generalmente enfrentan mucho menos riesgo de suscripcion medica que los beneficiarios en la mayoria de los otros estados.

heading.en: How Star Ratings work in Maine
heading.es: Como funcionan las Calificaciones de Estrellas en Maine

paragraphs.en: Maine Medicare Advantage plans, like every state's plans, are rated 1 to 5 stars by CMS each October based on roughly 40 quality measures covering chronic disease management, member experience, customer service, and Part D drug safety. Plans rated 4 stars or higher receive CMS quality bonus payments that typically fund richer benefits the following plan year.
paragraphs.es: Los planes Medicare Advantage de Maine, como los de todos los estados, son calificados de 1 a 5 estrellas por CMS cada octubre basandose en aproximadamente 40 medidas de calidad que cubren el manejo de enfermedades cronicas, la experiencia del miembro, el servicio al cliente y la seguridad de medicamentos Part D. Los planes calificados con 4 estrellas o mas reciben pagos bonus por calidad de CMS que tipicamente financian beneficios mas ricos en el siguiente ano del plan.

paragraphs.en: Maine's statewide weighted-average Star Rating for 2026 is 3.6, below the roughly 3.8 national average CMS reports. Humana and Aetna lead Maine carriers at 4.0 stars, while Martin's Point and Anthem sit closer to 3.5, part of a broader trend where CMS's stricter 2024-2025 measurement changes hit several regional and nonprofit carriers harder than large national plans. A handful of Maine plans have slipped below 3 stars, worth checking closely before you enroll or renew.
paragraphs.es: La calificacion promedio ponderada de estrellas de Maine para 2026 es 3.6, por debajo del promedio nacional de aproximadamente 3.8 que reporta CMS. Humana y Aetna lideran las aseguradoras de Maine con 4.0 estrellas, mientras que Martin's Point y Anthem se ubican mas cerca de 3.5, parte de una tendencia mas amplia donde los cambios de medicion mas estrictos de CMS de 2024-2025 afectaron mas a varias aseguradoras regionales y sin fines de lucro que a los grandes planes nacionales. Un puñado de planes de Maine ha caido por debajo de 3 estrellas, algo que vale la pena revisar de cerca antes de inscribirse o renovar.

heading.en: How to enroll in Maine Medicare Advantage
heading.es: Como inscribirse en Medicare Advantage de Maine

paragraphs.en: Maine residents enrolling in Medicare Advantage in 2026 follow the same federal process as the rest of the country, layered on top of Maine's own carrier and county quirks. Start at medicare.gov/plan-compare, where CMS runs a personalized plan finder tool keyed to your ZIP code, especially important in 2026 given that several plans across Maine were discontinued.

Documents needed before you start: your Medicare card showing your Medicare number and Part A/B effective dates, your ZIP code (plan availability varies sharply by county in Maine), a list of your current prescriptions with dosages, a list of your current doctors and preferred hospital system (MaineHealth, Northern Light Health, or Central Maine Healthcare), and your MaineCare card if you are dual-eligible.

Maine Medicare Advantage applications get delayed or denied for a handful of predictable reasons: late or incomplete Part B enrollment, a home address ZIP code that falls outside the plan's Maine service area (common near county borders), missing MaineCare eligibility documentation for a D-SNP application, identity verification mismatches with Social Security records, and applying for a Chronic Condition SNP without documented proof of the qualifying condition from a physician.

list.en: Step 1: Confirm your Medicare Part A and Part B eligibility. You must already be enrolled in both before joining a Medicare Advantage plan. If you're newly turning 65, your Initial Enrollment Period covers this step.
list.es: Paso 1: Confirme su elegibilidad para Medicare Parte A y Parte B. Debe estar inscrito en ambas antes de unirse a un plan Medicare Advantage. Si esta cumpliendo 65 anos, su Periodo de Inscripcion Inicial cubre este paso.

list.en: Step 2: Gather your documents. Medicare card, ZIP code, current prescription list, current doctors and hospital system, and MaineCare card if applicable (see the checklist above).
list.es: Paso 2: Reuna sus documentos. Tarjeta de Medicare, codigo postal, lista de recetas actuales, medicos y sistema hospitalario actuales, y tarjeta de MaineCare si aplica (vea la lista anterior).

list.en: Step 3: Compare plans at medicare.gov/plan-compare. Filter by your ZIP code and sort by Star Rating, monthly premium, total estimated annual cost, or maximum out-of-pocket. Maine residents can also call Maine's SHIP counseling program through their local Area Agency on Aging for free, unbiased guidance.
list.es: Paso 3: Compare planes en medicare.gov/plan-compare. Filtre por su codigo postal y ordene por Calificacion de Estrellas, prima mensual, costo anual estimado total o maximo de gastos de bolsillo. Los residentes de Maine tambien pueden llamar al programa de asesoria SHIP de Maine a traves de su Agencia de Area sobre el Envejecimiento local para orientacion gratuita e imparcial.

list.en: Step 4: Apply. Enroll directly through medicare.gov, by calling 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227), or through the carrier directly. Most online enrollments take 10 to 15 minutes.
list.es: Paso 4: Aplique. Inscribase directamente a traves de medicare.gov, llamando al 1-800-MEDICARE (1-800-633-4227), o a traves de la aseguradora directamente. La mayoria de las inscripciones en linea toman de 10 a 15 minutos.

list.en: Step 5: Confirm your coverage start date. AEP enrollments start January 1, 2027. SEP enrollments, including those triggered by Maine's 2026 plan discontinuations, typically start the first of the month after you enroll. You'll receive a member ID card and Evidence of Coverage from the carrier within 7 to 10 business days.
list.es: Paso 5: Confirme su fecha de inicio de cobertura. Las inscripciones de AEP comienzan el 1 de enero de 2027. Las inscripciones SEP, incluidas las activadas por las descontinuaciones de planes de 2026 de Maine, tipicamente comienzan el primer dia del mes siguiente a su inscripcion. Recibira una tarjeta de identificacion de miembro y Evidencia de Cobertura de la aseguradora dentro de 7 a 10 dias habiles.

heading.es: Planes de $0 de prima en Maine para 2026

paragraphs.en: Maine has $0 monthly premium Medicare Advantage plans available in 2026, concentrated in the more competitive southern counties (Cumberland, York, and Kennebec). $0 premium does not mean $0 cost: Maine residents in a $0 premium plan still pay the Part B premium ($202.90 per month in 2026) plus any drug copays, deductibles, and out-of-pocket costs the plan charges.

Fewer $0 premium options exist in Maine's rural north than in the state's southern corridor. Washington, Piscataquis, and Aroostook counties frequently have no $0 premium plan at all in a given year, one more reason rural Mainers should run a ZIP-code-specific search before assuming a $0 premium option exists where they live.

heading.en: MaineCare and dual eligibility in Maine
heading.es: MaineCare y doble elegibilidad en Maine

paragraphs.en: Maine residents who qualify for both MaineCare (Maine's Medicaid program) and Medicare at the same time are [dual eligible](/en/qa/can-i-have-both-medicare-and-medicaid). Dual-eligible Mainers can enroll in a Dual Special Needs Plan (D-SNP), which coordinates MaineCare and Medicare into one plan and typically carries $0 premiums, $0 primary care copays, and reduced prescription costs. UnitedHealthcare's Dual Complete plan is the most widely available D-SNP option in Maine for 2026.
paragraphs.es: Los residentes de Maine que califican tanto para MaineCare (el programa Medicaid de Maine) como para Medicare al mismo tiempo son doble elegibles. Los residentes doble elegibles de Maine pueden inscribirse en un Plan de Necesidades Especiales Duales (D-SNP), que coordina MaineCare y Medicare en un solo plan y tipicamente tiene $0 de prima, $0 de copago de atencion primaria y costos reducidos de medicamentos. El plan Dual Complete de UnitedHealthcare es la opcion D-SNP mas ampliamente disponible en Maine para 2026.

paragraphs.en: Dual eligibility also unlocks special enrollment rights: dual-eligible Maine beneficiaries can change MA plans, or move between MA and Original Medicare, once per quarter in Q1, Q2, and Q3, plus again during AEP. If your MaineCare eligibility status changes, or your income falls near the [Medicaid income limits](/en/medicaid-income-limits) for your household size, you may also qualify for a Special Enrollment Period.
paragraphs.es: La doble elegibilidad tambien desbloquea derechos especiales de inscripcion: los beneficiarios doble elegibles de Maine pueden cambiar de plan MA, o moverse entre MA y Medicare Original, una vez por trimestre en Q1, Q2 y Q3, ademas de otra vez durante el AEP. Si su estado de elegibilidad de MaineCare cambia, o su ingreso se acerca a los limites de ingresos de Medicaid para el tamano de su hogar, tambien puede calificar para un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial.

en.question: How many Medicare Advantage plans are available in Maine in 2026?
en.answer: Maine has 52 Medicare Advantage plans available statewide in 2026, per CMS Medicare Plan Finder data cross-referenced with the KFF Medicare Advantage 2026 Spotlight, down slightly from 54 in 2025 after Martin's Point, Aetna, and Anthem each discontinued plans. The exact number available to you depends on your county. Southern counties like Cumberland offer 24-28 plans; rural counties like Piscataquis may offer only 4. Run a ZIP-code search at medicare.gov to see your exact options.

en.question: What is the average Medicare Advantage premium in Maine for 2026?
en.answer: The statewide weighted-average Medicare Advantage premium in Maine is about $20 per month in 2026. Several HMO plans, especially WellCare offerings in southern Maine, charge $0 monthly premium, while PPO plans from Humana and Aetna average $28 to $32 per month. Rural counties in Maine's north and Downeast region tend to run $20 to $25 higher than the state average due to thinner carrier competition.

en.question: When can I sign up for Medicare Advantage in Maine?
en.answer: The main enrollment window is the Annual Election Period (AEP) from October 15 to December 7, 2026, for coverage starting January 1, 2027. You can also enroll during your 7-month Initial Enrollment Period around your 65th birthday, or during a Special Enrollment Period triggered by events like moving, losing employer coverage, qualifying for MaineCare, or your plan being discontinued (as happened to roughly 36,000 Mainers for 2026). Existing MA enrollees can switch plans during the MA Open Enrollment Period (January 1 to March 31, 2026).

en.question: Who has the best Medicare Advantage plans in Maine?
en.answer: Humana and Aetna currently lead Maine carriers on Star Ratings at 4.0 stars for 2026, ahead of Martin's Point and Anthem at roughly 3.5 stars. Martin's Point Generations Advantage remains Maine's largest carrier by enrollment and offers the deepest local network, especially valuable outside southern Maine. The best plan for you depends on your doctors, medications, and whether you value low premium, network breadth, or the highest available Star Rating.

en.question: Can I switch from Medicare Advantage back to Original Medicare in Maine?
en.answer: Yes. You can switch back during the Annual Election Period (October 15 to December 7) or the Medicare Advantage Open Enrollment Period (January 1 to March 31). Maine gives you an unusual advantage here: the state requires insurers to offer Medigap policies of equal or lesser benefit on a guaranteed-issue basis year-round, so long as you haven't had a coverage gap over 90 days, meaning Mainers face much less medical underwriting risk switching back than beneficiaries in most other states.

en.question: What is the difference between an HMO and a PPO in Maine Medicare Advantage?
en.answer: HMOs (about 30 of Maine's 52 plans, roughly 58%) require you to use in-network providers, usually anchored to MaineHealth, Northern Light Health, or Martin's Point's own network, and generally need a referral to see a specialist. They average $16 per month. PPOs (about 15 plans) let you see out-of-network providers at a higher cost share without a referral, averaging $32 per month. Rural Maine residents often prefer PPOs for the added flexibility to travel for specialty care.

en.question: Does Medicare Advantage cover prescription drugs in Maine?
en.answer: Most Maine Medicare Advantage plans bundle Part D prescription drug coverage, known as MA-PD plans. The 2026 Part D annual out-of-pocket maximum is $2,100 across all plans, set by the Inflation Reduction Act (signed August 16, 2022). Always check a specific Maine plan's formulary to confirm your medications are covered and at what tier before enrolling.

en.question: Are dental, vision, and hearing covered by Medicare Advantage in Maine?
en.answer: Most Maine Medicare Advantage plans include some level of dental, vision, and hearing benefits that Original Medicare does not cover. Coverage varies by carrier: some Maine plans cover only routine cleanings and eye exams, while others cover crowns, hearing aids, and prescription eyewear. Check each plan's Evidence of Coverage for annual dollar limits, especially important given the modest premiums many Maine plans charge.

en.question: What is a Special Needs Plan (SNP) and who qualifies in Maine?
en.answer: A Special Needs Plan is a type of Medicare Advantage plan restricted to people with specific needs. Maine offers 7 SNP plans in 2026: Dual Eligible SNPs (D-SNPs) for MaineCare and Medicare dual-eligible residents, Chronic Condition SNPs (C-SNPs) for people with qualifying conditions like diabetes or heart failure, and Institutional SNPs (I-SNPs) for residents of long-term care facilities. UnitedHealthcare's Dual Complete is Maine's most widely available D-SNP for 2026.

es.question: ¿Cuantos planes Medicare Advantage estan disponibles en Maine en 2026?
es.answer: Maine tiene 52 planes Medicare Advantage disponibles a nivel estatal en 2026, segun datos de CMS Medicare Plan Finder comparados con el Spotlight Medicare Advantage 2026 de KFF, bajando ligeramente de 54 en 2025 despues de que Martin's Point, Aetna y Anthem descontinuaran planes. El numero exacto disponible para usted depende de su condado. Los condados del sur como Cumberland ofrecen 24-28 planes; los condados rurales como Piscataquis pueden ofrecer solo 4. Ejecute una busqueda por codigo postal en medicare.gov para ver sus opciones exactas.

es.question: ¿Cual es la prima promedio de Medicare Advantage en Maine para 2026?
es.answer: La prima promedio ponderada estatal de Medicare Advantage en Maine es de aproximadamente $20 por mes en 2026. Varios planes HMO, especialmente las ofertas de WellCare en el sur de Maine, cobran $0 de prima mensual, mientras que los planes PPO de Humana y Aetna promedian $28 a $32 por mes. Los condados rurales del norte y la region Downeast de Maine tienden a ser $20 a $25 mas altos que el promedio estatal debido a la menor competencia de aseguradoras.

es.question: ¿Cuando puedo inscribirme en Medicare Advantage en Maine?
es.answer: La ventana principal de inscripcion es el Periodo Anual de Eleccion (AEP) del 15 de octubre al 7 de diciembre de 2026, para cobertura que comienza el 1 de enero de 2027. Tambien puede inscribirse durante su Periodo de Inscripcion Inicial de 7 meses alrededor de su 65 cumpleanos, o durante un Periodo de Inscripcion Especial activado por eventos como mudanza, perdida de cobertura del empleador, calificacion para MaineCare, o la descontinuacion de su plan (como le sucedio a unos 36,000 residentes de Maine para 2026). Los inscritos actuales en MA pueden cambiar planes durante el Periodo Abierto de MA (1 de enero al 31 de marzo de 2026).

es.question: ¿Quien tiene los mejores planes Medicare Advantage en Maine?
es.answer: Humana y Aetna actualmente lideran las aseguradoras de Maine en Calificaciones de Estrellas con 4.0 estrellas para 2026, por delante de Martin's Point y Anthem con aproximadamente 3.5 estrellas. Martin's Point Generations Advantage sigue siendo la aseguradora mas grande de Maine por inscripcion y ofrece la red local mas profunda, especialmente valiosa fuera del sur de Maine. El mejor plan para usted depende de sus medicos, medicamentos y si valora prima baja, amplitud de red o la Calificacion de Estrellas mas alta disponible.

es.question: ¿Puedo cambiar de Medicare Advantage a Medicare Original en Maine?
es.answer: Si. Puede cambiar de regreso durante el Periodo Anual de Eleccion (15 de octubre al 7 de diciembre) o el Periodo Abierto de Medicare Advantage (1 de enero al 31 de marzo). Maine le da una ventaja inusual aqui: el estado exige a las aseguradoras ofrecer polizas Medigap de beneficio igual o menor bajo emision garantizada durante todo el ano, siempre que no haya tenido una brecha de cobertura de mas de 90 dias, lo que significa que los residentes de Maine enfrentan mucho menos riesgo de suscripcion medica al cambiar de regreso que los beneficiarios en la mayoria de los otros estados.

es.question: ¿Cual es la diferencia entre un HMO y un PPO en Medicare Advantage de Maine?
es.answer: Los HMOs (unos 30 de los 52 planes de Maine, aproximadamente 58%) requieren que use proveedores de la red, generalmente anclados a MaineHealth, Northern Light Health o la propia red de Martin's Point, y generalmente necesitan una referencia para ver a un especialista. Promedian $16 por mes. Los PPOs (unos 15 planes) le permiten ver proveedores fuera de la red a un costo compartido mas alto sin referencia, promediando $32 por mes. Los residentes rurales de Maine a menudo prefieren los PPO por la flexibilidad adicional para viajar por atencion especializada.

es.question: ¿Medicare Advantage cubre medicamentos recetados en Maine?
es.answer: La mayoria de los planes Medicare Advantage de Maine incluyen cobertura Part D de medicamentos recetados, conocidos como planes MA-PD. El maximo anual de gastos de bolsillo Part D 2026 es $2,100 en todos los planes, establecido por la Ley de Reduccion de la Inflacion (firmada el 16 de agosto de 2022). Siempre verifique el formulario de un plan especifico de Maine para confirmar que sus medicamentos esten cubiertos y en que nivel antes de inscribirse.

es.question: ¿Medicare Advantage cubre dental, vision y audicion en Maine?
es.answer: La mayoria de los planes Medicare Advantage de Maine incluyen algun nivel de beneficios dentales, de vision y audicion que Medicare Original no cubre. La cobertura varia por aseguradora: algunos planes de Maine cubren solo limpiezas de rutina y examenes de la vista, mientras que otros cubren coronas, audifonos y lentes recetados. Revise la Evidencia de Cobertura de cada plan para conocer los limites anuales en dolares, especialmente importante dadas las primas modestas que cobran muchos planes de Maine.

es.question: ¿Que es un Plan de Necesidades Especiales (SNP) y quien califica en Maine?
es.answer: Un Plan de Necesidades Especiales es un tipo de plan Medicare Advantage restringido a personas con necesidades especificas. Maine ofrece 7 planes SNP en 2026: SNPs de Doble Elegibilidad (D-SNPs) para residentes doble elegibles de MaineCare y Medicare, SNPs de Condicion Cronica (C-SNPs) para personas con condiciones calificadas como diabetes o insuficiencia cardiaca, y SNPs Institucionales (I-SNPs) para residentes de centros de cuidado a largo plazo. Dual Complete de UnitedHealthcare es el D-SNP mas ampliamente disponible de Maine para 2026.
